• Mokama New Railway Bridge | Ground Reality | Rajendra Setu | Bihar Railway Project*
Bihar ke Mokama mein Ganga River par ban raha *New Dual-Track Railway Bridge* ab apne final stage mein pahunch chuka hai. Existing Rajendra Setu ke parallel banaya gaya ye new bridge Mokama–Barauni region mein railway capacity ko improve karne wale important projects mein se ek hai.
Is video mein hum *Rajendra Pul Railway Station se Hathidah Upper Junction aur aage ke railway connectivity sections* tak project ki ground reality dekhenge.
